alkylation_concentration.evidence: The centrifuged protein supernatants were reduced by 1 M DTT (Dithiothreitol, Roche, 10197777001), alkylated by IAM (Iodoacetamide, Sigma, I6125).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Trypsin/Lys-C Mix (Promega, V5072) was added at the weight ratio of enzyme:protein as 1:50, and the digestion was carried out at 37°C overnight.

fractionation_method.value: Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation Kit (Thermo, 84868)
fractionation_method.evidence: Equal amounts of labeled samples were mixed together, fractionated, and desalted using the Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation Kit (Thermo, 84868).

labeling.evidence: The peptides were then labeled with TMT126–TMT131 (Thermo, 90061), and the reaction was quenched with 5% hydroxylamine.
